watch_items.text: Unit cost: CASK ex-fuel rose by {{cask_ex_fuel.change@FY2024}} to {{cask_ex_fuel@FY2024}}, so non-fuel costs absorbed part of the revenue gain.

Customer prepayments: advance ticket cover of {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2024}} is above the peer median of {{advance_ticket_cover.peer_median@FY2024}} but the weakest of the group ({{advance_ticket_cover.peer_rank@FY2024}}), a sensitivity if bookings slow.

Committed facilities: undrawn committed credit facilities fell by {{undrawn_facilities.change@FY2024}} to {{undrawn_facilities@FY2024}}, so a larger share of liquidity now rests on cash of {{cash_like@FY2024}}.

Maturities: debt due within one year rose by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2024}} to {{debt_due_1y@FY2024}}, covered {{short_term_debt_cover@FY2024}} by liquidity, so refinancing needs to be met without drawing down the cash buffer.
